The '''''Intruder''-class starfighter''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] model used by [[Zodoh]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].

==History==
The ''Intruder'' served as Zodoh's main attack craft as he went on his starfighter raids in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. The [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]] ''[[Voracious]]'' carried these starfighters.
